items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: Then there were a lot of blacks even turned on to Gene Austin, who -- I think he sold more -- nobody's ever topped his "Blue Heaven," I don't think.

ctx.x: Yeah, she was big before Bing and I think she gave up her career to have babies and you know, like become a housewife and she just dropped everything. I'm pretty sure, because I remember -- and Gene Austin.
